name: SIFC Investor Visa

requirements.blocker_text: Applicant must intend to invest in Pakistan and hold a Recommendation Letter/Email from the Special Investment Facilitation Council (SIFC).
requirements.fix_path: Obtain a SIFC recommendation for the intended investment.

evidence_required.document: Proof of legal residence (if applying from a third country)

outcome.duration_length: Short-term: 3 years multiple entry. Long-term: 5 years multiple entry. Extension: 2 years multiple entry.

sources.title: Pakistan Online Visa System (NADRA) -- SIFC Investor Visa: for citizens of foreign countries intending to invest in Pakistan, open to both Business Visa List and non-BVL countries; requires a SIFC Recommendation Letter/Email; short-term entry 3 years multiple entry, long-term entry 5 years multiple entry, extension 2 years multiple entry

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Pakistan). Published: the only hard requirement actually specified in the source (a SIFC recommendation) is tier-1 sourced. GENUINE GAP, NOT FABRICATED: no minimum investment AMOUNT is stated anywhere in the source retrieved -- unusual for an investor-residence route in this dataset, where a numeric capital threshold is normally the marquee figure. A separate general 'Business - Investor Visa' category exists on the same NADRA portal (visa.nadra.gov.pk/business-investor-visa/) that may carry its own numeric threshold, but that page returned a 403 error on every fetch attempt in this build and could not be independently verified -- flagged for follow-up rather than guessed at. work_rights set to 'restricted' since the visa is residence/entry-focused, not an explicit open work-rights grant. Set up in parallel with Pakistan's Special Investment Facilitation Council (SIFC), a civil-military hybrid body created in 2023 to fast-track foreign investment -- distinctive in this dataset for the investment-visa gatekeeper being a body outside the ordinary immigration bureaucracy.
